<div id="ctl00_cphRoblox_rbxUserPlacesPane_ctl02_rbxPlatform_rbxVisitButtons_ClientInstaller_Panel1" class="modalPopup" style="height:700px;width:400px;display: none">
			
    <div style="padding: 0 0 1em 0">
        <h3>
            Running Roblox</h3>
        <p>
            A window will open asking what you want to do with a file called "Roblox.exe".</p>
        
                <p>
                    Click "Run" (or "Open" if there is no "Run" button).</p>
                <p>
                    <img id="ctl00_cphRoblox_rbxUserPlacesPane_ctl02_rbxPlatform_rbxVisitButtons_ClientInstaller_Image1" src="images/Install/DownloadPrompt.PNG?b" style="border-width:0px;" /></p>
                <p>
                    Another window will open asking you to confirm. Once again, click "Run".</p>
